job: the context of a line as DATA a model reads with it: the sentences around it, and an on-screen string's other strings and the words said while it shows

old_copy.deleted_with: the launch-video lane lead removes tools/copy-gate on a launch-video branch once this lands (this session may not write there)

preserve: a prose line's context is the sentence before and after it within its own block, never crossing into another line
an on-screen string's context is the other strings of its option spec and the words spoken from lead_s before it shows until it leaves
a text not found gives null context with the reason; the judged text never appears in its own context
allowed_deltas: the named files' text is handed in (holding, build(sources, files)); a file not handed in is not found
the command is one JSON request in and one JSON answer out instead of build <sources> --out <file>
banned_substitutions: a context filled from anywhere but the named files
